        prev = ri[k - 1]
        nxt = ri[k + 1]
        old = matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][nxt]
        new = matrix[prev][nxt]
        return new - old

    base_total = total_cost(routes)

    max_outer = 3
    for _ in range(max_outer):
        improved = False
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            ri = routes[i]
            if not ri:
                continue
            for k in range(len(ri)):
                node = ri[k]
                new_load_i = loads[i] - demands[node]
                delta_remove_i = route_remove_cost_delta(ri, k)

                best = None  # (delta_total, j, pos)
                for j in range(len(routes)):
                    if j == i:
                        continue
                    if loads[j] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    pos, delta_insert_j = best_insertion_cost(routes[j], node)
                    delta_total = delta_remove_i + delta_insert_j
                    if best is None or delta_total < best[0] - 1e-12:
                        best = (delta_total, j, pos)
                if best is None:
                    continue
                delta_total, j, pos = best
                if delta_total < -1e-12:
                    # apply mutation
                    apply_removal(ri, k)
                    loads[i] = new_load_i
                    apply_insertion(routes[j], pos, node)
                    loads[j] += demands[node]
                    base_total += delta_total
                    improved = True
                    break
            if improved:
                break
        if not improved:
            break

    # Phase 1.5: inter-route exchange (1-1) with best reinsertion (deterministic first improvement)
    # Keeps feasibility; typically helps clustered bottleneck instances.
    max_exchange_rounds = 2
    for _ in range(max_exchange_rounds):
        improved = False
        nr = len(routes)
        for i in range(nr):
            if improved:
                break
            ri = routes[i]
            if not ri:
                continue
            for j in range(i + 1, nr):
                if improved:
                    break
                rj = routes[j]
                if not rj:
                    continue

                # scan nodes deterministically (smaller index first)
                for ki in range(len(ri)):
                    if improved:
                        break
                    node_i = ri[ki]
                    dem_i = demands[node_i]
                    for kj in range(len(rj)):
                        node_j = rj[kj]
                        dem_j = demands[node_j]

                        # Check capacity after swap
                        if loads[i] - dem_i + dem_j > capacity:
                            continue
                        if loads[j] - dem_j + dem_i > capacity:
                            continue

                        # Build reduced routes by removal (temporary)
                        ri2 = ri[:]  # small: route lengths aren't huge; still bounded
                        rj2 = rj[:]
                        # remove in reverse order not needed; indices valid before removal
                        del ri2[ki]
                        del rj2[kj]

                        # Best insert node_j into ri2, node_i into rj2 (independent evaluation)
                        # If routes become identical empties, insertion still works.
                        pos_i_in_j, delta_ins_i = best_insertion_cost(rj2, node_i)
                        pos_j_in_i, delta_ins_j = best_insertion_cost(ri2, node_j)

                        # Compute true delta using route costs for safety (interpretable, deterministic)
                        old_cost = route_cost(ri) + route_cost(rj)
                        new_ri = ri2[:]
                        new_rj = rj2[:]
                        apply_insertion(new_ri, pos_j_in_i, node_j)
                        apply_insertion(new_rj, pos_i_in_j, node_i)
                        new_cost = route_cost(new_ri) + route_cost(new_rj)
                        delta_total = new_cost - old_cost
                        if delta_total < -1e-12:
                            # apply
                            routes[i] = new_ri
                            routes[j] = new_rj
                            loads[i] = loads[i] - dem_i + dem_j
                            loads[j] = loads[j] - dem_j + dem_i
                            base_total += delta_total
                            improved = True
                            break
                if improved:
                    break

        if not improved:
            break

    # Intra-route 2-opt improvements (few passes, deterministic first improvement)
    def two_opt_first_improve(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return False
        for i in range(n - 3):
            a = route[i]
            b = route[i + 1]
            for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                c = route[j]
                d = route[j + 1]
                delta = (matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d])
                if delta < -1e-12:
                    route[i + 1:j + 1] = reversed(route[i + 1:j + 1])
                    return True
        return False

    max_passes = 2
    for _ in range(max_passes):
        any2 = False
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            if two_opt_first_improve(routes[i]):
                any2 = True
        if not any2:
            break

    # Final cleanup: remove empty routes (none expected, but safe)
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    return routes
